question: For Nintendo's first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (April 1 - June 30, 2026), what were net sales and operating profit in yen, how much did Nintendo say it recorded as a reduction of cost of sales from refunds of U.S. IEEPA tariffs, and - converting that refund at the quarter's average rate of JPY 159.38 per US dollar - what was operating profit excluding the refund and how did it compare with the prior-year quarter's JPY 56.9 billion?
grading: Key points (all required): (1) net sales JPY 517.8 billion (-9.5% y/y); (2) operating profit JPY 142.5 billion (+150.5%; prior-year JPY 56.9 billion); (3) tariff refund approximately US$300 million recorded as a reduction of cost of sales; (4) at JPY 159.38/USD the refund is about JPY 47.8 billion, so operating profit excluding it is about JPY 94.7 billion (accept JPY 92-97 billion), roughly +66% versus JPY 56.9 billion (accept +62% to +70%). The answer must flag the conversion as an approximation. Fail if the quarter is mislabelled (e.g., Jan-Mar 2027), if the refund is treated as a yen figure disclosed by Nintendo, or if operating profit ex-refund is not computed.
answer: Q1 FY3/2027 (April 1-June 30, 2026): net sales JPY 517.8 billion (-9.5%) and operating profit JPY 142.5 billion (+150.5% from JPY 56.9 billion). Nintendo said it recorded approximately US$300 million as a reduction of cost of sales for refunds of IEEPA tariffs [W11-E1]. At the average rate of JPY 159.38/USD that is about JPY 47.8 billion, so operating profit excluding the refund is about JPY 94.7 billion, still about +66% y/y. The full-year forecast (operating profit JPY 370.0 billion) was unchanged from May [W11-E1]. Switch 2 hardware sold 3.82 million units in the quarter [W11-E1].
